review.notes: Full review. Suggested.lean elaborates with 11 sorry warnings only; one-tactic probe on seven theorems closes none. Dependency check: 0 problems. Worker's automatic checks all passed. Overlap read against five closest roadmaps: nothing shared. A public Lean formalisation of the same subject (formal-mathfin) is reported to the human reviewers and asked about; Lehmann 1966 not readable.
